_about: The town round the ground (src/render/stadium/town.ts lays it out, scenery.ts draws it from public/assets/stadium/scenery.glb, modelled by scripts/assets/scenery-kit.py). Distances in metres. The ground's plaza reaches 130 by 115 from the centre spot.

grid._about: Streets run on a grid. plazaHalf is how far the ground's own plaza reaches (src/render/stadium/model.ts); plaza is the centre line of the ring road round it; inner are the extra streets that split the blocks beside the plaza; block is the spacing of the streets further out and count how many of them there are each way. road is a street's width, kerb to kerb.

levels._about: Heights of the flat ground, far enough apart not to flicker from a long way off.

tiers._about: Per graphics detail (0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High): how many blocks are built (nearest the ground first), how many of those get the detailed houses and trees, and whether cars park along the streets.

mix._about: How often each kind of block turns up (weights). Shops face the ground from the blocks beside the plaza, car parks sit off its two ends, and there is one church; works only stand at least worksFrom metres out.

ground._about: The ground's own furniture, the same at every size of stadium (the biggest stands reach 98 m along the pitch and 78 m across it from the centre spot, and the shop, kiosks and floodlights stay within 101 m and 112 m). Dugouts stand dugoutsAt either side of halfway in front of the main stand (z is towards it), with the tunnel between them; flags at the pitch's corners; a gate in the middle of each side of the plaza with flagpoles beside it; trees in planters round the plaza's edge; and the team coaches by the main stand. Colours named club1 and club2 are the club's own.

country._about: Beyond the streets: a patchwork of fields out to fieldsTo, each about fieldSize across with a gap for its hedge, some with a line of trees along one side (hedgeTrees, by detail) and woods of woodTrees trees each (woods, by detail) between woodsFrom and woodsTo. The hills are one model, a ring from 780 m to 1,500 m out.

skyline._about: The city centre on the horizon: towers (by detail) scattered within spread of the point at, at least gap apart, taller towards the middle.

clouds._about: Clouds (by detail) between from and to metres out, between the two heights, so they never come between the Stadium tab's camera and the ground. glow is how much they shine by themselves by day and by night, on top of the sky's light (it keeps their undersides from going dark).
